blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Batangas Rep. Gerville Luistro has reminded the public that the evidence gathered and presented by the prosecution against Vice President Sara Duterte — particularly the bank and tax records under Article II — are documents that came from her camp. Luistro said this on Friday after a recent Social Weather Stations (SWS) survey showed that only 30 percent of the respondents were happy with the prosecution, while 35 percent were displeased — for a net satisfaction rating of -5.
